description: Experience levels rescale requirement importance and rebalance the scoring weights. A student is not penalised on the same experience axis as a senior hire - the weight moves to projects and education instead.

levels.title: Internship
expectations: Coursework, personal projects and internships count as evidence
Fundamentals matter more than breadth of tooling
One deep project beats five shallow ones

levels.title: Entry Level (0-2 years)
expectations: Demonstrated ability to ship something complete, however small
Clear fundamentals in the core language and CS basics
Projects should show independent problem solving

levels.title: Mid Level (2-5 years)
expectations: Ownership of production features or systems
Evidence of measurable impact in a professional setting
Depth in the primary stack plus working knowledge of adjacent systems

levels.title: Senior (5+ years)
expectations: Design ownership and technical leadership on non-trivial systems
Mentorship, cross-team influence or hiring involvement
Business or user impact stated in outcome terms
